{{Quote|Well, the legends surrounding my disappearance were correct. The ''Ray'' was indeed caught in the Tyus Cluster, and at the center of that mass of ugly black holes, time was nonexistent. Many others had been trapped there before me, though none had survived. Except for one&hellip; a Jedi Master. She helped me escape, and even taught me a little about the Force.|Kinnin Vo-Shay to Nyo|<ref name="AJ13">{{JournalCite|13|The Last Hand (short story)}}</ref>}}
The '''Tyus Cluster''' was a cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] located in the [[Tyus sector/Legends|Tyus sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
The Tyus Cluster was one of several obstacles that [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] encountered while charting the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Many ships were lost there since it was discovered, the most famous being the ''[[Ashanda Ray]]'', a unique [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] ship manned solely by [[Kinnin Vo-Shay]]. Much later, Kinnin Vo-Shay reportedly returned to [[Morado]] 50 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after he went into the Tyus Cluster, in the exact condition before he went in.<ref name="AJ13" />
